_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_PDF/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_PDF/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Written 2026-10-10 from Docs_UNI_SIM/store-listings/universal-pdf.md (Data safety, checked against the code 2026-09-14): opening, filling, signing, marking up and converting a PDF happen on the device and collect nothing; sign-in (@unisim/sdk) is optional (password, emailed code, or Apple/Google/Microsoft); Send to sign uploads the PDF and the signer's email. Sending a document to a signer is a transfer the user starts, not sharing. The suite user count (@unisim/sdk presence.js) sends a random install id the app makes itself and the platform when the app opens and every 45 s in use, signed in or not, plus the account id once signed in: App interactions + Device or other IDs, required, Analytics (as Ergo Assess and Universal QR; brought in line 2026-10-10). Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
